company.name: TWADDAN
company.shortDescription: Twaddan, the first marketplace for mobile car washes, offers on-demand services with real-time arrival estimates for consumers.
company.description: Twaddan App is a groundbreaking Emirati platform redefining the car wash industry. It offers a seamless, on-demand mobile car wash experience, allowing users to book services at their convenience, whether at home, work, or anywhere else. Twaddan partners with a network of professional service providers, ensuring top-quality and eco-friendly cleaning options. The app boasts a user-friendly interface, secure payment methods, and real-time tracking, making it easy for users to manage their car wash needs. With a commitment to innovation and customer satisfaction, Twaddan is poised for significant growth.
company.headquarters: Umm Al Qawain, Umm Al Quwain, United Arab Emirates
